reviews.author: Sophie
reviews.text: Extremely nice and kind! I got my car stuck on some ice, and they were able to get it free in less than 30 minutes after I called. Definitely one of the most reasonably priced services I’ve come across. Could not thank them enough for all that they do!

reviews.author: Katie Davis
reviews.text: He blessed us today with getting my car unlocked as fast as possible, he is fast and efficient. Very respectful man, I highly recommend this business bc it’s the best I’ve ever seen. Very nice guy.

reviews.author: Ronnie Esquivel
reviews.text: After waiting 1.5 hours for AAA to find us a tow. I decided to call Total Towing ourselves. Willy answered promptly, arrived in 15 minutes like he said, charged a fair price, and was very personable during the ride. Highly recommended! AAA will reimburse us for the tow. I'm so glad we called. Thanks again, Willy!

reviews.author: Tracie Wallace
reviews.text: The young man that towed my disabled vehicle was quick, courteous and efficient. He gave my grandson and I a ride to the nearest gas station after my accident and waited with us until family arrived.

reviews.author: Zomby Woof
reviews.text: Willy, the owner/operator is a great guy to do business with. Friendly, easy to talk to. Gave me extended service beyond the tow I needed. Said he'd be to me in 15 minutes, he was early. Better price than another tow company I had previously used. I'd youre in Mount Airy and need a tow, you'll want to call Total. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Lori Holder
reviews.text: We needed help tonight and AAA was MIA but Total Towing was on the spot. Extremely nice and ready to help. They will be my number one call in the future!

reviews.author: Barbara Seymour
reviews.text: I was from out of town and had a vehicle accident in Mt Airy . I feel like Total Towing goes above and beyond . I forgot to get the license plate off my van and he mailed it to me to save us from having to drive up there again. I very much recommend this business . In today's world it's refreshing to come across good ,honest ,and helpful people. That is priceless!

reviews.author: Tori Bates
reviews.text: After my car messing up on the way home from visiting with family me and my two boys were stranded - Total Towing was awesome! I had to go to a hotel because I couldn’t get a rental! He came picked up my keys, went to pick up my car, and got a battery put in for me! He was very quick with everything and very nice. i would recommend them to anyone and wish we had more people like him where im from! they were absolutely amazing. Thank you so much Total Towing! You were my lifesaver.

reviews.author: Lindsay
reviews.text: Huge thanks to Willie for coming up the mountain to help me when I locked my keys in my running car. Responsive as soon as I called and great to work with. I would recommend to anyone in the area and he will be my first call for anything I need in the future.

reviews.author: laurie vogler
reviews.text: My car broke down an hour away from home. I called and spoke with Willy on Friday after thanksgiving and he said he would be glad to get it. He had it back home that same afternoon, this was the most positive experience. Willy was prompt, professional and very nice. I would recommend his service to anyone needing a tow!

reviews.author: Brooke Leland
reviews.text: Best tow experience ever. Willie was the driver he was extremely helpful and friendly. We broke down with are kid's going back to indiana he gave us a ride to the hotel let us get what we needed found a mechanic open and close to us even called after going above and beyond and said if we needed anything to let him know. If you ever need a tow call this guy seriously. And it was a great price. He was truly a blessing

reviews.author: Jared Edwards
reviews.text: I have used Total Towing 6 times since March of 2021. Each time Willie has been quick, professional and careful with my vehicle / vehicles. I liked the service so much, I’d give him a call during down time to tow purchased vehicles to my residence. Give Willie a call for any of your towing needs!

reviews.author: Fred Bobbitt
reviews.text: My wife and I blew a tire on our camper coming home from the beach. We called good sam roadside serviceand they called toll towing. We made contact and within a half hour they guy shows up and had us up and going in minutes. I failed to get the guys name but man he was great,friendly and very courteous. I would recommend total towing to anyone with a roadside problem. Great job.

reviews.author: Joell Montgomery
reviews.text: Total Towing was so very helpful! My 3 kids, my 2 sisters, and I were stuck in Mt Airy in the rain with a flat tire. I called Total Towing to change the tire but when he arrived, we discovered that the tool needed to get the spare off was not in the SUV. Although it was almost closing time, he was able to get me in at Parrish Tire and they had the tools needed to get the spare put on to get me home. He was professional and friendly and his rate was very reasonable. I highly recommend this business!

reviews.author: James Gwyn
reviews.text: I have used Total Towing many times hands down wouldn't use any other towing service, Willy answers the call and gets to you quickly,great prices on his services .I recommend him to anyone who needs a towing service!! Great guy. Call him for your towing needs .

reviews.author: Ork
reviews.text: Willy was very professional and worked with us to tow our cargo van to a location to get the freight transferred from our cargo van to a recovery cargo van. After that, he towed us all the way to Fort Mill, SC and gave us a reasonable price to do so.

reviews.author: itsjustMaya !
reviews.text: "I had an excellent experience with Total Towing! They were incredibly prompt and got there when i need them. They were professional, courteous, and handled my car with great care. I was particularly impressed by their customer service, which kept me informed and reassured throughout the entire process. I highly recommend Total Towing for anyone in need of reliable and efficient towing services!"

reviews.author: Richard Ferguson
reviews.text: Great prices and very easy to get along with. They are very fast at getting your vehicle wherever you want it. Would recommend this company to anyone who is in need of a tow! As for the person that said that he is overcharging for a tow.... it was a "accident" tow and they have a set price across the board. Before you go bashing this company call around and see for yourself. Most companies charge double what he charged you, you should be grateful not ungrateful. I get so annoyed by the ones that think you should work for free. Let see how you would be if your employer told you that they was not going to pay you and that your to expensive!

reviews.author: Barbara Flinchum
reviews.text: June 29, my son’s car would not start. He was to depart for the military the next day. I was terrified he would not be able to return to his base on time. The young man came to tow his vehicle and asked if he could try charging his battery. We tried earlier but it didn’t work. Fortunately, it worked this time. The young man followed me to Advance Auto and sent a text to make sure I was ok. It’s rare to find people who will take care of you this day and time. Thank you and God bless the young man for his kindness.

reviews.author: Charles Faw
reviews.text: Called them to haul my son's car home due to a bad starter. Quick and professional service, reasonable price. Wouldn't hesitate to call them again. A+

reviews.author: sophie c
reviews.text: Said he would tow our car between Friday and monday morning, completely ghosted us. Never answered calls or texts and didn’t get our business. would not recommend. so unprofessional and rude to ignore customers after agreeing to our business.

reviews.author: Blessing Wade
reviews.text: Unlike many of the other road assistance/towing services Willie actually answered the phone. He provided services in a timely manner, and was very helpful. 10/10 recommend.

reviews.author: Emily H
reviews.text: Great Service! The absolute best! Saving me time, money and stress is an understatement! If you’re ever in need, Willie is the man to call!

reviews.author: Jason Townsend
reviews.text: This place is awesome best towing company I have ever used. Went above and beyond to help me amd my family. Highly recommended. Big shot out to Willy you are truly a great guy. Thanks!

reviews.author: Cindy baldwin
reviews.text: Amazing experience! Owner Willie went above and beyond to help my handicapped sister and myself from a bad breakdown on I-77. Very kind and professional!!!

reviews.author: Chris Flanagan
reviews.text: My wife and I were stuck on the side of the hwy 52 when we ran out of gas and then total towing came up beside us to ask if we needed help and we hadnt even called them, I told him we ran out of gas so he towed us to the gas station at no charge, he was extremely kind and understanding of our situation, I forgot to ask his name but thank you very much for stopping when you did on a dangerous road late at night.

reviews.author: Susan Ratcliff
reviews.text: $200 to tow my car half a mile after an accident. Told me he HAD to tow my car to his lot (for the storage fees) - ENTIRELY not true. My insurance will pay the bill this time but they will never get any more of my money.

reviews.author: Garrett Boles
reviews.text: I have used this company multiple times, They have always been good to me! I have also referred several friends whom have all been pleased with the services provided and also used numerous times! The owner don’t want your arm and leg...just your TOWS!!!

reviews.author: Joseph Marshall
reviews.text: This place is amazing I was in a total bind and locked my keys in the truck and Willie came out and got my truck unlocked for me and when I say quick I called him and not even 15 minutes later he was here I absolutely recommend this place to anyone for any towing needs!! Thank y’all !!!

reviews.author: Viola Troup
reviews.text: Very nice people got my car quick and with no issues. Price was reasonable. Will totally recommend to others.

reviews.author: Mathew Marcotte
reviews.text: Honest, VERY helpful and priced right; so glad I found this company, they go above and beyond what I expect out of roadside service. HIGHLY recommend!

reviews.author: Alexis Snow
reviews.text: We had a break down tonight and despite the time, I was given a good price and excellent service! I would recommend TOTAL TOWING to anyone who has experienced a breakdown or wreck.

reviews.author: Josh Pendleton
reviews.text: Tow truck driver arrived quickly and got me and my car where I needed to be quickly and safely. He even dropped my car right into the parking spot I needed it.

reviews.author: madi hiatt
reviews.text: I highly recommend Total Towing, they are a A+ Towing service. They are reasonable, dependable, friendly and get there fast!

reviews.author: Cindy Susan kincaid
reviews.text: They came to the site and pulled me out and followed me to my bank to get paid. Will was very helpful.
